title: Isaiah Bible Quiz - Chapter 29
description: Ten questions on Isaiah 29: woe to Ariel, the sealed book, lip-service worship, and the deaf who will hear.

questions.text: How is Ariel described in the opening woe?
questions.explanation: The woe is to Ariel, Ariel, the city where David encamped.

answers.text: The city of the great king
The city set high on a hill
The faithful city full of justice

questions.text: What does Yahweh say he will do against Ariel?
questions.explanation: He says, "I will encamp against you all around you, and will lay siege against you with posted troops."

answers.text: Send famine and pestilence into her streets
Encamp against her and lay siege with posted troops
Scatter her people among all the nations
Shut up her gates and seal them forever

questions.text: From where will Ariel's speech whisper after she is brought down?
questions.explanation: Her speech will mumble out of the dust, and her voice will whisper out of the dust, as of one who has a familiar spirit out of the ground.

questions.text: To what is the multitude of nations fighting against Ariel compared?
questions.explanation: They will be like a dream, like a hungry man who dreams he eats but awakes with his hunger unsatisfied.

answers.text: A wave that breaks and vanishes on the rock
Smoke that is scattered and vanishes in the wind
A hungry man who dreams he eats but awakes unsatisfied
An arrow that is shot and misses its mark

questions.text: What does the educated man say when told to read the sealed book?
questions.explanation: When the sealed book is delivered to one who is educated with the words "Read this, please," he says, "I can't, for it is sealed."

questions.text: What complaint does the Lord make about this people's worship?
questions.explanation: They draw near with their mouth and honor him with their lips, but they have removed their heart far from him.

answers.text: They honor him with their lips, but their heart is far away
They sacrifice to idols on every high place
They bring offerings with hands full of blood
They swear falsely by his name in the gates

questions.text: What will happen to the wisdom of the wise men?
questions.explanation: Yahweh will do a marvelous work, and the wisdom of their wise men will perish, and the understanding of their prudent men will be hidden.

answers.text: It will be written in a book
It will spread to the nations

questions.text: What does the thing made say about its maker, in the picture of the potter and the clay?
questions.explanation: Those who turn things upside down are like the thing made saying about its maker, "He didn't make me," or "He has no understanding."

answers.text: "Why have you made me like this?"

questions.text: What will Lebanon be turned into in a very little while?
questions.explanation: Isn't it yet a very little while, and Lebanon will be turned into a fruitful field, and the fruitful field regarded as a forest?

questions.text: What will the deaf hear in that day?
questions.explanation: In that day the deaf will hear the words of the book, and the eyes of the blind will see out of obscurity and darkness.
